blind_spots: 11 PLAN.md §5 mean-score line edits across history (multi-grader prose means, a different quantity from table scores). A boost smuggled via §5 prose would not trip the STATUS check. Watcher covers the verdict table (the rung-1 gate input), not narrative means.

Coincidence as run = same-commit HELD-exit. One real coincidence escapes that definition: demo-9 700->550 coincided with RECUSED->CLEARED (1ccddf90) — clean (downward, cited), but the mechanical form must watch ANY verdict-change, not HELD-exits only. Amendment below.
Author-score vs non-author-score distinction lives in receipts, not diffs: the check sees score deltas, not whose score moved.
detector_gap_disclosed: RECUSED->CLEARED coincidence (demo-9) escapes the as-run HELD-exit definition; included by hand, clean. Mechanical form amended to any-verdict-change (see mechanical_check).
hypothesis: git IS the watcher: every verdict-table score lives in STATUS.tsv, so `git log -p --follow` is a complete record of every score edit; same-commit score-change + hold-resolution without a separate score receipt trips the condition with no volunteer.
limit_note: Proves no smuggled boost in the table's history; does not prove none could land in prose. The condition as amended is enforceable on machine-readable state only — which matches the file's own contract (lane-status.sh exits 3 on schema violations).
mechanical_check: for each commit touching STATUS.tsv: parse pre/post rows; flag commits where any score delta coincides with any verdict-change on any row AND the commit cites no *score* receipt (demand/hunt/rung2-score file) distinct from the hold-resolution receipt. One-liner form: extend the Q62 awk gate — any RULED_OUT-adjacent score delta without a cited score receipt fails lane-status.sh.
method: parsed pre/post STATUS.tsv at all 32 touching commits (oldest-first); score delta = score-field change on an existing row; hold-exit = any row HELD->non-HELD same commit (gap: RECUSED->CLEARED handled by hand, see blind_spots); receipt = row receipt column + commit message.

result.direction: ALL DOWNWARD (900->820, 940->885 x5 pattern, 700->550). Zero upward score moves in lane history — there was never a boost to smuggle.
